name: sled 45 degrees wide stance leg press
description: A 45 degree sled leg press with a wide foot position that brings in the inner thighs and glutes.
instructions: Sit in the sled with your back flat on the pad and feet wide on the platform, toes slightly out.
Lower the sled with your knees tracking over your toes.
Press back up without locking your knees.
Keep your hips on the seat.
